# ZTAPI

> Public documentation for the ZTAPI unified model API.

Base URL: https://ztapi.vip/v1
Authentication: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ZTAPI_API_KEY

## Documentation
- [API reference](https://ztapi.vip/docs/api)
- [Integration guide](https://ztapi.vip/docs/integration)
- [Codex setup with search and page reading](https://ztapi.vip/docs/codex)
- [User guide](https://ztapi.vip/docs/user-guide)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://ztapi.vip/docs/faq)
- [Resource sources and pricing](https://ztapi.vip/docs/resource-disclosure)
- [Live models and pricing](https://ztapi.vip/models)

## Public endpoints
- GET /v1/models
- GET /codex/models
- POST /v1/chat/completions
- POST /v1/completions
- POST /v1/responses
- POST /v1/responses/compact
- POST /v1/messages
- POST /v1/embeddings
- POST /v1/images/generations
- POST /v1/images/edits
- POST /v1/audio/transcriptions
- POST /v1/audio/translations
- POST /v1/audio/speech
- POST /v1/rerank
- POST /v1/video/generations
- GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}
- POST /v1/videos
- GET /v1/videos/{task_id}
- GET /v1/videos/{task_id}/content
- POST /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent

## Model selection
Copy the exact public model ID and use its supported endpoint from the live catalog.
Not every model supports Chat Completions. Responses-only models require /v1/responses.
Image and video models use their dedicated endpoints. Poll video tasks using the task ID.
Never silently substitute a different model. Do not publish or share API keys.
Prices, availability and capabilities come from the live catalog, not this index.

## Codex
Complete setup: https://ztapi.vip/docs/codex
Use Responses, the ZTAPI_API_KEY environment variable, and the exact verified model zt-claude-opus-5.
env_key is the variable NAME, not the API key: keep env_key="ZTAPI_API_KEY". Set and export the real key in the same terminal that starts Codex.
Missing environment variable is a local credential lookup failure before a model request. auth.json does not replace the explicitly named provider environment variable.
Optional CLI launchers (hidden key entry, process-only environment; no auth.json, config.toml or sandbox changes):
https://ztapi.vip/assets/ztapi-codex-20261104.sh
https://ztapi.vip/assets/ztapi-codex-20261104.ps1
Do not request customer API keys in support chats, paste keys into env_key, or promise unverified old-client search support.
Set web_search="live" at TOML root and model_catalog_url="https://ztapi.vip/codex/models" inside the provider table.
Search and page reading use gateway-hosted tools; no client-side DeepSeek key is required.
Each successful nonempty search or page read costs CNY 0.01; model tokens are billed separately.
Explicit failures, empty results and find over cached page text have no tool fee.
For support, provide the request ID, model and time without credentials: https://t.me/gan66
